# Confirm

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Confirm:Int32 text:String, serious:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | In | String | required | The question. |
| `serious` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 for the warning symbol, 0 for information. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** 1 for OK, 0 for Cancel.

## Description

Shows a question with an OK and a Cancel button and waits for the answer. Lines can be split with `Chr$(13)`. The second parameter chooses a warning symbol instead of the information symbol.

## Differences

* The box is a message box of the operating system in front of the program's active window, not part of it. When the program runs without a screen it writes the text to the error output and answers 0.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
If Confirm("Delete all saves?", 1) Then
	Notify "They are gone."
EndIf
```
